            font-weight: 400;

                /* Keep JW Player's own caption container geometry intact. Changing

        .jwplayer .jw-text-track-container {
            transition: none !important;

        body.vnx-subtitles-initializing .jwplayer .jw-text-track-container,

            display: none !important;
            visibility: hidden !important;
            opacity: 0 !important;
